text: …　…　まけちゃった　けどね

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃった is the casual short form of てしまった, which says the thing happened completely, often to your regret. まけちゃった = 'I ended up losing'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.span: まけちゃった　けどね
patterns.explanation: けど at the end means 'though', taking back a little of what was just said. まけちゃった　けどね = 'I ended up losing, though'.
